title: Knowledge Distillation — Telugu + English Learning
subtitle: Original English diagrams, formulas, labels and code unchanged.

questions.stem: Knowledge Distillation అంటే ఏమిటి? Large Teacher నుంచి Small Student Model ఎలా Learn చేస్తుంది?
options: Teacher Full Network, Weights Studentకి Exactly Copy చేస్తాం.
Small Student Teacher Predictions నుంచి Useful Behavior Learn చేస్తుంది.
Teacher Only Student Examplesతో Retrain చేసి Student Weights Ignore చేస్తుంది.
Teacher Extra Labels Gather చేసి Student Independentగా Trains చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Big Teacher Predictionsని Small Student Learn చేస్తుంది. All Weights Copy చేయదు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Teacher Usually Fixed; Student Soft Predictions, Hidden Features నుంచి Own Weights Train చేస్తుంది.

questions.stem: Edge Devicesకి Knowledge Distillation ఎందుకు Useful? Small Student Memory, Compute ఎలా Save చేస్తుంది?
options: Large Teacher Remote Storageలో ఉంటే Phone Offline Fully Runs అంటుంది.
Every Layer Wider చేసి Less Training Data Use చేస్తాం.
Difficult Classes Remove చేసి Architecture Unchangedగా Keep చేస్తాం.
Teacher Skills Small Studentకి Transfer చేసి Resources Save చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Small Student Less RAM, Compute Use చేయవచ్చు. Useful Accuracy Preserve చేయాలి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Compact Model Storage, Memory, Latency Reduce చేయవచ్చు. Actual Quality, Hardware Speedపై Test చేయాలి.

questions.stem: Teacher Cat, Dog, Rabbit Probability Scores Studentకి Hard Labelకంటే More Information ఎలా ఇస్తాయి?
options: Soft Predictions Other Animal Classes గురించి Studentకి Clues ఇస్తాయి.
Teacher Highest Label Only Keep చేసి All Other Probabilities Discard చేస్తుంది.
Student Teacher Every Weight Copy చేసి Training Entirely Avoid చేస్తుంది.
Class Probabilities Dataset Animal Image Counts Only Indicate చేస్తాయి.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Teacher Cat 70%, Dog 20%, Rabbit 10% అనవచ్చు. Student Alternatives కూడా Learn చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Hard Label Correct Class Shows; Soft Scores Plausible Alternatives Reveal చేస్తాయి. Percentages Illustrative.

questions.stem: Soft Targets, Hard Labels, Temperature, KL Distillation Loss కలిసి Student Trainingలో ఎలా Work చేస్తాయి?
options: Temperature Hard Labels Change; KL Teacher Accuracy Only Measure చేస్తుంది.
Hard Labels Confidence Scores; Soft Targets One Correct Category Only Hold చేస్తాయి.
Hard Labels Correct Class Teach; Soft Teacher Scores KLతో Guide చేస్తాయి.
KL All True Labels Remove; Temperature Student Parameter Count Set చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Real Label Correct Answer Shows. Teacher Soft Probabilities Similar Choices Teach చేస్తాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Hard Label Cross-Entropy + Temperature-Softened Teacher/Student KL Loss Combine చేస్తాం. Typical Loss α·CE+(1−α)·T²·KL.

questions.stem: PyTorchలో Fixed Teacher Logits, Student Cross-Entropy, KL Loss Combine చేసి Training ఎలా చేస్తాం?
options: Teacher, Student Both Gradients Update; Input MSE Only Use చేస్తాం.
Teacher Freeze; Two Losses Combine చేసి Student Weights Update చేస్తాం.
Hard Labelsపై KL Only Use; Teacher Probabilities Completely Ignore చేస్తాం.
Teacher Argmax Labels Only Use చేసి Soft Scores Remove చేస్తాం.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Teacher Freeze చేస్తాం. True Labels, Teacher Soft Scores రెండింటి నుంచి Student Learn చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. teacher.eval(), torch.no_grad()తో Teacher Logits. Studentపై CE + Temperature-Scaled KL Loss Compute చేసి Only Student.backward() Updates చేస్తాం.

questions.stem: Response-Based, Feature-Based, Relation-Based, Self-Distillationలో Knowledge Transfer ఎలా Differ అవుతుంది?
options: Output Scores, Hidden Features, Relations Studentకి Transfer చేస్తాం.
Only Hard Labels Transfer; Training Duration మాత్రమే Different ఉంటుంది.
Teacher Layer Sizes, File Formats, Hardware Layout Only Transfer చేస్తాయి.
Model Parameter Counts, Training Speed, Vocabulary Order Only Match చేస్తాయి.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Student Final Predictions మాత్రమే కాదు, Hidden Features, Relationships కూడా Learn చేయవచ్చు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Response Probabilities Match; Feature Hidden States Align; Relation Pairwise Structure Preserve; Self-Distillation Previous Checkpoint Guidance Use చేస్తుంది.

questions.stem: Large Teacher నుంచి Small Studentకి Distill చేస్తే Reasoning Loss, Error Copy, Data Shift Risksని ఎలా Reduce చేస్తాం?
options: Student Size Increase చేస్తే All Capacity Problems Without Testing Solve అవుతాయి.
Easy Teacher Examples Only Use చేస్తే Rare Cases Automatically Preserve అవుతాయి.
Teacher Answers Unfiltered Copy చేసి Compression తర్వాత Evaluation Skip చేస్తాం.
Staged Teaching, Curated Data, Multiple Teachers Use చేసి Quality Test చేస్తాం.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Small Student Important Skills Lose చేయవచ్చు. Better Examples, Several Teachers, Evaluation Help చేస్తాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Capacity Gap, Teacher Errors, Distribution Shift, Forgetting Student Quality Reduce చేయవచ్చు. Progressive Training, Data Selection, Multi-Teacher Signals, Retention Benchmarks Use చేయాలి.
